notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten sheet lists Western Idaho State Fair / Boise ID, 208-287-5650. Adventure Zone emailed Bob Batista again July 31, 2026. Official fair information already publishes the expanded 2027 fair dates as Aug. 13-29, 2027.
